value=memoryview(b"abc")
a=dir(value)
b=dir(value)
a[0]="changed"
print(a is b,"changed" in b,len(b),len(set(b))==len(b))

value=memoryview(b"abc")
a=object.__dir__(value)
b=value.__dir__()
a[0]="changed"
print(a is b,"changed" in b,len(b))

value={7}
it=iter(value)
value.add(9)
dir(value)
print("before")
next(it)

value=memoryview(b"abc")
a=dir(value)
d=value.__dir__
value.release()
print(a==dir(value),len(d()),len(value.__dir__()),d.__self__ is value)

storage=bytearray(b"abcd")
parent=memoryview(storage)
value=parent[::-1]
d=value.__dir__
parent.release()
del parent
del value
del storage
print(len(d()),d.__self__.tobytes()==b"dcba")

a=set()
b=memoryview(b"a")
d=object.__dir__.__get__(a)
e=object.__dir__.__get__(b,type(a))
print(d.__self__ is a,e.__self__ is b,len(d()),len(e()),d.__qualname__,e.__qualname__)
